constraints: Call once per parameter to be included in the SOAP request; value is generally $param1/$param2/... (the proxy method's own parameters) but any declared 4D variable/array can be used.
Does not support 4D.Blob class objects as value (only classic Blob and other primitive/variable types).

protocolRefs.multiCallChain: Web Services (Client) SOAP call sequence: WEB SERVICE AUTHENTICATE (optional) and/or WEB SERVICE SET OPTION (optional) configure per-call client state -> WEB SERVICE SET PARAMETER is called once per request parameter to build the SOAP message -> WEB SERVICE CALL sends the request (consuming the authenticate/option/parameter state and erasing any previous result) -> WEB SERVICE GET RESULT retrieves each returned value (pass '*' on the final call to free memory) -> on error, WEB SERVICE Get info can be called from an ON ERR CALL method to inspect the SOAP fault.

overloadMerges.note: Restored sentinelValues on soapType listing the documented primary SOAP data type strings; autoparse leaves it as a plain optional Text with no enum.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the parameter as it must appear in the SOAP request

params.name: value
params.description: 4D variable containing the value of the parameter

params.name: soapType
params.description: Forces the SOAP type of the parameter, overriding 4D's automatic type inference from value's content

sentinelValues.meaning: Date and time in ISO8601 format, e.g. 2003-05-31T13:20:00
Qualified XML name (namespace and local part)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Registers a named parameter (name/value, optionally forced to soapType) to include in the SOAP request built for the next WEB SERVICE CALL.
